verdict.rationale: SumUp can be driven headlessly. Static API keys let an application act on the merchant's behalf, and the @sumup/sdk runs in server runtimes such as Node.js 18+, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel. Sandbox merchant accounts, test cards and Virtual Solo let automated flows run without physical hardware, and a community developer built an integration through the public API rather than the app. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/CD pipeline guidance, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
